findings.title: Primary and secondary-index streams repeat the held-head control state machine
findings.friction: Two implementations must preserve identical pull admission, comparison charging, held-head retention and page-stop rules.
findings.canonical_owner: Existing physical-stream owner, sharing only held-head control with static dispatch.
findings.action_trigger: Before another held-head backend or a change to its accounting/resume contract.
findings.boundary: Retain backend-specific key encoding, physical seek configuration, refill bounds and prefix-merge state.
findings.state_space_delta: No new public or persisted state; one control contract replaces two handwritten implementations.

findings.title: Named-type direct dependency enumeration is implemented in schema digest and runtime lowering
findings.friction: Each named-type shape change requires maintaining two equivalent variant walkers and nested field-type walkers.
findings.canonical_owner: Schema NamedTypeFragment/FieldType representation, enumerating direct dependencies only.
findings.action_trigger: The next authorized named-type/schema-creation cleanup, before extending fragment shapes.
findings.boundary: Retain digest reachability/canonicalization and catalog-native validation/allocation as separate callers; never rebuild accepted definitions from generated models.
findings.state_space_delta: No new public mode or persisted form; one direct-dependency traversal replaces two.

findings.title: Standalone predicate and SQL statement parsers duplicate the trailing-token diagnostic map
findings.friction: A diagnostic-code mapping change must update two exact copies.
findings.canonical_owner: Existing ungated parse-error boundary, sharing only token-to-diagnostic projection.
findings.action_trigger: The next authorized parser diagnostic edit; qualify SQL-enabled and SQL-disabled builds.
findings.boundary: Keep statement/predicate grammars, feature admission and trailing-clause ordering at their current parser owners; do not move statement policy into the lexer.
findings.state_space_delta: No added grammar, feature flag or runtime route; one diagnostic projection replaces two.

findings.title: Dynamic numeric capability classifiers repeat tables already owned by the scalar registry
findings.friction: Two handwritten Value variant lists require synchronization with separate authoritative registry flags.
findings.canonical_owner: Existing scalar registry, projected into const Value capability classifiers.
findings.action_trigger: The next authorized scalar capability edit, if direct registry projection preserves the lightweight execution shape.
findings.boundary: Keep is_numeric_value and supports_numeric_coercion as distinct capabilities; coercion_family has a different truth table.
findings.state_space_delta: No merged capabilities or added mode; remove independently maintained variant lists.

findings.title: Fifty-nine test files independently construct the same budgeted request profile
findings.friction: Changing the shared test profile requires changing 59 helper definitions and their budget-construction imports.

findings.action_trigger: A bounded shared-test-setup cleanup; preserve every behavioral assertion and custom budget profile.
findings.boundary: Keep 16,000,000 uniform test limits and 500,000,000/64 KiB failure headroom; production request/read/mutation budgets remain independent.
findings.state_space_delta: No production state or API; one test factory replaces 59 equivalent constructions.
